Commentary.Commentary: Right then. It has been yet another destructive performance by the Kiwis and they deservedly go up 1-0 in the 3-game T20I series. Not a lot of time for Bangladesh to retrospect and they will want to make a comeback in the second game which is a series-decider of sorts as if the visitors lose, then the series will go the way of the Blackcaps. The 2nd T20I of the series will be played on Tuesday, 30th March 2021 at 1900 local (0600 GMT). We hope to have your company for that game. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Tim Southee, the captain of New Zealand, says that it was nice and putting up such a performance with a young team is pleasing. Mentions that Will Young has been around for some time and it was pleasing to see him do well today and also Devon Conway who is carrying on with his great form. Feels that when you have a couple of guys knocking on the door, it is a great sign. Says that you stick to your plan with the ball but it is always nice to have runs on the board. Regarding Lockie Ferguson, Southee replies that it is not easy to come back from an injury break but he will be happy with the way he bowled.

Mahmudullah, the Bangladesh skipper, says that their bowlers bowled quite well and praises Nasum Ahmed for his spell. Feels that they let themselves down once again in the batting department and need to pick themselves up. Lauds Devon Conway for his knock and mentions that he has been in great form. Reminds that they had a chance to dismiss him but failed and adds that they need to find ways to get him out. Mahmudullah further opines that 190 was a good score here to chase but they conceded a few more boundaries at the death. Calls Ish Sodhi an experienced campaigner and feels that the ball was gripping for him. Tells that they cannot afford to repeat the same mistakes again and again.

PLAYER OF THE MATCH IS DEVON CONWAY! He starts by saying that he is pretty happy with the way things went today. Calls it happy days. Mentions that you got to be really positive (after losing wickets) and is glad that it came off for him. Tells that it was awesome to bat with Will Young. Shares that for him it's all about watching the ball and sticking to the basics, although sometimes he does try to premeditate his reverse-batted shots.

Clinical show by the Blackcaps despite missing plenty of first-team players. Devon Conway and debutant Will Young set the right tone in their batting innings and it was capped off by some insane hitting at the death by Devon and Glenn Phillips. A total in excess of 200 was always going to be difficult to overhaul and the Kiwi bowlers did the job exceedingly well to earn an easy win. Stay tuned for the presentation...

It anyway was a stiff target to chase for the Bangla Tigers and it became next to impossible after they lost 4 wickets in the Powerplay. Their flavourless batting show on this tour continued and had Afif Hossain and Mohammad Saifuddin not combined for a partnership, the defeat margin would have been even bigger.

Bangladesh have been beaten black and blue here in the first T20I! Everyone expected the Kiwi pacers to do the damage but as it turned out, Ish Sodhi, the leg spinner, blew away Bangladesh's top order. Once again Ish was in top gear, picking up his second 4-wicket haul in two months and it was strange to see a team from the subcontinent struggle against a leggie..

EDGY FOUR! A boundary to wrap up this game. On a good length and close to off, Mohammad Saifuddin swings his willow at this and the ball takes the outside edge, goes over point and into the ropes, on a couple of bounces. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 66 RUNS!
A slower short ball around off this time, Mohammad Saifuddin again swings his blade at this but fails to connect bat with ball.
Around off, length, punched to the covers.
This time, this is short and around off, Mohammad Saifuddin goes back and looks to cut, but this is way too close to his body to cut. So, he misses.
Well bowled this time. Sees Mohammad coming down the track and hence, Daryl Mitchell bowls this one fuller and wider outside off, Mohammad Saifuddin cannot reach out.
SIX! WHAM! On a good length, around the off pole, Mohammad Saifuddin comes down and cracks this one over the long on region.
Around off, on a length, worked to the short third man uppishly, but it lands ahead of the man there. 6 balls left, can New Zealand bowl out Bangladesh?
A low full toss on middle, slogged away to deep mid-wicket for a single. Wanted two but would have been way too risky.
A yorker on off, Mohammad Saifuddin again does well to dig this one out.
Another length ball on middle, Mohammad Saifuddin keeps this one out.
Around middle, length, punched back to Hamish, who fails to stop the ball, but it goes onto hit the stumps at the other end.
Nasum Ahmed is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! A STUNNER! What a catch and this is a beauty from Guppy. He followed the ball all the way and put in a full length dive to take this catch, on this 100th T20I game for him. A length ball, around off, Shoriful Islam slices this one over the point region, where Martin Guptill runs behind, keeps his eyes on the ball and dives to take a stunning catch.
Hamish Bennett is back to operate. 0/19 in his 3 overs.
FOUR! In the gap and a boundary. On a good length around off, Mohammad Saifuddin slams this one through extra cover and the ball finds the ropes.
An off pace ball on off, Islam pushes this one, off the toe end of the bat, to covers for one.

A chance to take the catch but Tim was a bit late in his reflexes. A slower ball around off, Shoriful Islam slams this one back to where it came from. Tim Southee gets his hands across and gets his fingers to the ball but fails to hold on. The ball goes towards the mid off region.
WIDE. Short and around off, Islam misses his shot and the umpire flexes his arms, to signal a wide.
FOUR! SLAM! On a good length and around off, whacked through extra cover for a boundary.
Player review for a caught behind! Tim Southee takes the DRS and it turns out to be one of the worst ever. Daylight between bat and ball.

NOT OUT! An optimistic review but it yields nothing for the Blackcaps. On a good length and around off, Islam looks to play at this one through the off side but misses and the ball goes to the keeper, Conway, who takes it nicely. An appeal for caught behind, but the umpire is unmoved. Tim wants the review and so, he takes it upstairs. A big gap between ball and bat and the Ultra Edge confirms the same.
On a good length and around off, Mohammad Saifuddin chips this one over mid on, for a single.
Length and around off, pushed to the point fielder. 89 needed in the last 3 overs. Safe to say that this game is done and dusted.
A short ball around off, Shoriful Islam moves leg side and looks to play the upper cut but he misses.
Shoriful Islam is the new batsman.

OUT! TIMBER! Afif loses his stumps, after displaying some good strokes. Lockie Ferguson bowls a full toss on the leg pole as he sees Afif Hossain making room to the leg side. Afif looks to guide this one to the off side but he misses due to the extra pace. The ball crashes into the leg pole and Bangladesh lose their 7th here. 89 needed in 20 balls.
FOUR! Terrific shot and this was almost a six. On a good length, around off, Afif Hossain stands his ground and lofts this one with a straight bat over the mid off region for a boundary.
A full toss around off, this is guided to the short third man region.
Bowls a very nice yorker on middle, MS does well to dig this one out, to the square leg region for a single.
Lockie Ferguson to bowl out. 1/20 from him so far.
A pace off ball around off, pushed to covers for an easy single. 4 off this one. 94 needed off the last 4 overs.
Around off, length, nudged through mid-wicket for a quick single.
Outside off, on a back of a length, AH comes down and slaps this one, but only finds the cover fielder.
Way too short and outside off, left alone. Wided.
SWING AND A MISS! A back of a length delivery, around the off pole, Afif Hossain looks to swing this one across the line but misses.
Back of a length on off, pulled to mid-wicket for a single.
SWING AND A MISS! Southee bowls a short ball wide outside off, Mohammad Saifuddin comes down the track and swings his blade at this. Fails to connect.
Tim Southee is into the attack again. 1/19 in his 2 overs so far.
Short and on middle, Saifuddin swings his bat and pulls it behind square leg for a run.
Width on offer outside off, it's steered to deep point for a single.

Tries to be innovative but fails to connect. A length delivery wide outside off, Hossain walks across the stumps for the paddle scoop but then realizes that it's too wide. Tries to play the ramp shot at the last moment but misses.

Sent back in time! Short in length outside off, it's slapped straight down the ground to mid off where it finds Southee. Saifuddin wants a run but is sent back as Southee misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Slower short ball round off, Saifuddin stands back and taps it down to point for one.
Angling away from the batsman, on a good length, Afif dabs it down to third man for a run.
Hamish Bennett is back into the attack from the City End. 2-0-15-0 are his figures so far.
Short again, on middle, pulled down to deep mid-wicket for one. 12 from the over, the 50-run stand is up!
FOUR! Short in length and on middle, Afif rides the bounce and bangs his pull shot to the deep mid-wicket fence.
A length delivery around leg, MS tries to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects towards cover-point and they cross.
Off pace delivery, on a length and wide outside off, Afif chops it down on the off side for one.

FOUR! Cut and cut well! 100 up for Bangladesh! Short in length and wide outside off, Afif whacks it through point and it races away. Beats the diving effort by Lockie Ferguson in the deep and finds the fence.
Starts with a slower one, full and on off, Saifuddin pushes it gently to the off side for a run.
Daryl Mitchell is into the attack now.
On middle, whipped away through mid-wicket for a single. 114 needed in 42 balls.
That was a spicy bumper on this occasion. Bowls this one around off and middle, Mohammad Saifuddin just sways away from the line of the ball and lets it through.
Another short ball on off, Mohammad Saifuddin pulls this one past the man at short mid-wicket, to the deep, for a couple of runs.
Outside off, slapped away to deep cover for a single.
Short and around off, slower one too, AF pulls this one to deep mid-wicket, where Daryl Mitchell dives to his right and does well to stop the ball. A single.

EGDED...SHORT! On a good length, around off, Afif Hossain looks to run this one down this to the third man region, but he only manages a thin outside edge, which goes towards Devon Conway but on a bounce.
Lockie Ferguson is back on. 2-0-14-1 from him so far.

Short and around off, punched to deep covers for a single. Sodhi is done for the evening as he finishes with figures of 4-0-28-4. Outstanding stuff from the leggie, just missing out on bettering his best bowling figures in this format. It's also 4/28 which came against Australia in Christchurch last month.
On off, played to the off side for a single.
WIDE. Slipped down the leg side and MS misses his tuck away. Wide signalled.
FOUR! WHAM! Mohammad Saifuddin is looking for the boundaries here and he is looking good. Short and around off, Mohammad Saifuddin goes back and whacks this one through mid-wicket.
Around off, cut away to short third man for a single.

In the air...safe! Tosses this one up and lands it around off, Mohammad Saifuddin slams this one towards the long off region, where Daryl Mitchell runs ahead, but the ball lands in front of him. One run.
Short on middle, pulled to the right of the deep square leg fielder for a single.
DRS time! It's for an lbw shout against Mohammad Saifuddin. Seems to be going down the leg side. Missing leg. Review is lost for the Blackcaps.

NOT OUT! A review taken but it clearly looked to be going down the leg side here. Short and on the leg pole, Mohammad Saifuddin looks to tuck it to the on side but he misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal from Glenn Phillips but the umpire is unmoved. They go for the review but as thought earlier, it was going down leg.
Flatter again this time and on middle, MS smothers the ball out.
Shortish and on off, punched to the cover region.
On off, driven through covers for a single.
TWO WIDES. Slipped down the leg side, Mohammad Saifuddin leaves this one and the keeper fumbles and allows the batters to cross ends.
Darted on middle, nudged through square leg for one more run.
Short and around off, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Glenn Phillips to have a crack with the ball.
On middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a single. 135 needed from 10 overs.
Flat, outside off, Afif Hossain reverse sweeps this one to the man at short third man for a single. A good diving stop.
SIX! Going, going, goneee! Wonderfully hit. Given a nice flight and landed around off, Afif Hossain skips down the track and clubs this one all the way over the long off fence.
Shortish and outside off, slapped away to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up around off, MS blocks, from within the crease.
Full and tossed up and on off, Afif sweeps this one hard to the long on region for a single.
Shortish and on middle, Hossain goes for the pull but fails to middle it well. It's a bit uppish initially but goes safely to mid on. A single to close the over.
FOUR! Put away! Slightly too full from Lockie and it's too straight in line as well, Afif picks it off his pads and whips it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Mishit! Ferguson digs in a short ball on off, Afif mistimes his pull shot in the air and it lands safely outside the ring at mid-wicket. Two taken.
On a length and close to off, Afif stays back and defends it to the off side.
Shortish and on off, Hossain forces it from the crease and this time Guptill makes a fine stop to his right.

PUT DOWN! Almost a ripper from Guptill. A full toss on middle and leg, following the batsman, Afif slaps it uppishly to the left side of point where Guptill flies in that direction but fails to hang on.
Lockie Ferguson is back on.

No hat-trick on this occasion for Sodhi, but this has been another wonderful over by him. Floated and full around off, Mohammad Saifuddin dabs this one to the off side, with soft hands. 6 runs and two wickets from this one.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the new batsman. Hat-trick ball coming up...

OUT! DRAGGED ON AGAIN! Sodhi has his fourth and he is on a Hat-trick too. Can you believe this? This is like a replica of the previous delivery. Another short ball around off, a googly, Mahedi Hasan looks to tap this one to the off side, but the ball bounces slightly more and takes the inside half of the bat, and then goes onto hit the furniture behind. The visitors lose their 6th wicket and there seems to be no coming back into this game for them.
Mahedi Hasan walks in next.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Sodhi gets another one this time. Bangladesh in complete disarray here as half their side is back in their hut. Flatter and around off, Mahmudullah looks to play this one to the off side but the ball takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the timber behind him.
Shortish around off, Mahmudullah looks to cut but the ball takes the bottom edge and goes to the off side.
Tossed up and around off, driven through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Flighted around off, Mahmudullah lofts this one over the cover region and into the ropes.
FOUR! Edgy! Skidding away from the left-hander outside off, Afif waits for it and then delicately eases it past short third man for a boundary. 50 up for Bangladesh!
Sliding down the leg side, Mahmudullah premeditates his paddle scoop and sends it down to fine leg for one.
Fuller and on the pads, it's worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Skidding into the batsman, Mahmudullah tries to heave but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter and outside off, played down in front of point for a run.
Quicker delivery on middle, worked in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Afif Hossain is the new batsman. Mark Chapman to bowl now...

OUT! Bowled 'em! Two wickets in the over for Sodhi and Bangladesh are in a big spot of bother. 44/4 in the Powerplay. Deception from Ish, it's the wrong 'un which is bowled slower through the air, Mithun kneels down for an ugly swipe across the line but misses the ball completely. The stumps are shattered and Bangladesh are in tatters.
Short and on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mahmudullah is the new batsman. The skipper needs to steady the ship here.

OUT! Great caught and bowled by Sodhi, diving to his right! A well-disguised wrong 'un, landing full and close to off, Sarkar fails to read the variation as he closes the face of the bat early in an attempt to flick it on the leg side. It lobs back to the bowler off the leading edge and Sodhi dives across to his right to complete an excellent one-handed catch. 168 needed off 86 balls.
Extra loop this time, full and floated on leg, Sarkar clips it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball around off, driven through the line but straight to covers.
Loopy and full on middle, Mithun drags it off the inner half to the leg side for a run.
Ish Sodhi is into the attack now.
Width on offer outside off, Mithun runs it down to third man for a run. 7 runs and a wicket from the over!

Short and on middle, it's pulled behind square leg for a couple of runs. Glenn Phillips slides in the deep and sends in a flat throw to the keeper as the batsmen complete the second run. The replays show that a direct hit at the striker's end would have found Mithun short.
Sharp delivery again, 148 kph, Mithun swings his bat late and it comes off his thigh pad.
Almost chops it on! Good length ball close to off, skidding off the surface, Mithun tries to run it down but gets an inside edge and it bounces over the stumps.
Mohammad Mithun is the number 4 batsman.

OUT! Plumb in front! Lockie gets his revenge immediately. A 147 kph delivery, it's full and in the line of the stumps, Naim tries to be adventurous as he shuffles across the stumps for a heave-ho across the line. Fails to connect and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Naim looks at his partner and gets the suggestion to not take the DRS. The young man walks back.

FOUR! What a shot! Naim is not bothered about the extra pace of Lockie. He gets a length ball in his half and smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. The youthful exuberance is always a delight to watch!
Bowling change. Lockie Ferguson is unleashed into the attack.
On a length and outside off, it's slapped towards cover-point for one. 9 from the over!
Short in length and outside off, Sarkar carves it towards backward point for one.
Fuller and on middle, hacked across the line to mid-wicket for a single.

Clean effort in the deep by Finn Allen! Bennett pitches it up and outside off, Naim unfurls a square drive and it races away. Allen runs across to his left from third man, puts in a slide near the fence and pulls it back. The ball though starts to roll towards the line again as he picks it up. The onfield umpire gets it checked upstairs and is told by the third umpire that it's a clean piece of fielding. Two added to the total.
Stays inside the crease to a length ball and chops it down to point.
FOUR! Crunched! A cutter from Bennett, around off on a length and it grips as well but Naim is in his zone, he takes a good positive stride forward and creams his drive through covers.
Swing and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Sarkar tries to pull but misses.
FOUR! Sarkar is off the mark with a fine back foot punch. Southee serves it on a length outside off, Sarkar moves back and forces it in the gap at extra cover for a boundary.
Slower one, on a length around middle, Naim drops it with gentle wrists to mid-wicket and pinches a single.
Wide! Too wide outside off, short in length, Naim swishes and misses.

OUT! Southee strikes! He sprinkles his variation on this ball by rolling his fingers and serves it on a length around middle, Liton is a shade early into his shot across the line and it balloons in the air off the leading edge. Ish Sodhi settles underneath it at mid on and takes the skier safely. First blow to Bangladesh. 191 runs needed in 105 balls!
Soumya Sarkar walks out at Number 3.
FOUR! Swung away! Southee goes wide of the crease as he delivers a shortish ball on middle and leg, Liton turns inside the crease and powers it over square leg for a boundary.
Good length ball on top of off, just a hint of shape, Das stays back and taps it down to backward point.

Swing and a miss! Pace off from Hamish, it's full and on middle, angling down, Liton fails to flick and it goes off his pads to the leg side. They cross for a leg bye. Good comeback by Bennett in the over after conceding a boundary on the first ball.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, fuller in length again, Das allows it through to the keeper.
Liton tries to give himself room by walking down the leg side, Bennett follows him with a fuller length delivery and Das only manages to push it towards mid on.
Bennett pitches it up and outside off, Naim drives it down to mid off and picks up a single. Liton is on strike for the first time now in this run chase.
A bit of width on offer outside off, Naim slaps it off his back foot but finds the point fielder.
Well bowled! On a good length around middle, some extra bounce as it moves back into the left-hander, Naim fails to defend and it goes off his thigh pad to short third man.
FOUR! Naim is looking in fine touch, enjoying the good batting conditions. Short in length and around middle, Naim stands back and swings it behind square leg for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Naim taps it down on the leg side for one.
Who will partner Tim with the new ball? Hamish Bennett, it is.
Some shape there for Southee as he pitches it full around middle, Naim defends it back.
Slower one, on a back of a length on off, Naim plays it late but find short third man.
FOUR! Second in the first over! A full toss outside off, Naim needs no second invitation to put it away as he smashes it through cover-point for a cracking boundary.
Short in length and outside off, Naim slaps it through the line but finds point.
FOUR! Bangladesh are underway with a boundary! Fuller in length around off, just a hint of shape for Southee, Naim slices his drive past backward point for a boundary.
